chronicle.text: Doukail tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Mebeis tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Mebeis tied stone and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Thairos struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Gasas tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Seidu tied a club and a carrier together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
